[0;1mPeektrace 0.0.0-dev[0m

[0;1mUSAGE[0m

  peektrace [global flags] <command>

[0;1mDESCRIPTION[0m

  Local, loopback-only inspector for Claude Code, Codex, Pi and OpenCode
  sessions: context-budget forensics, stats and Claude memory.

[0;1mCOMMANDS[0m

  serve             Start the local web UI
  tui               Browse sessions in a terminal UI
  sessions ls       List session headers
  sessions analyze  Show context forensics for one session
  sessions export   Export one session to HTML, Markdown or JSON
  sessions search   Find sessions by text, redacted by default
  stats             Rank what fails and what costs time across all sessions
  stats drill       Show the evidence behind one finding
  stats prompt      Print a prompt to hand the report to an agent
  stats usage       Show token and cost usage over time
  stats refresh     Rebuild the stats index
  memory ls         List projects with memory, or the entries of one project
  memory show       Show the frontmatter and full body of one entry
  memory rm         Delete one entry (blocked under --read-only)
  statusline        Print one-line context health for a status line
  mcp               Serve read-only session and stats tools over stdio MCP
  doctor            Write a redacted telemetry bundle for support
  upgrade           Upgrade the installed binary to the latest release

[0;1mGLOBAL OPTIONS[0m

  --json                 Emit raw JSON instead of rendered tables
  --read-only            Refuse any mutating command (safe mode)
  --pretty               Render aligned tables, not tab-separated text
  --remote <url>         Use `peektrace serve` over HTTP (PEEKTRACE_TOKEN)
  --otel                 Log Effect spans to stderr (or set PEEKTRACE_OTEL)
  --no-telemetry         Disable local wide-event telemetry (on by default)
  --log-level <level>    Set the minimum log level
  --completions <shell>  Print a completion script
  -v, --version          Print the version
  -h, --help             Show help

[0;1mEXAMPLES[0m

  peektrace serve
  peektrace sessions analyze --latest
  peektrace stats --days 7

Run peektrace <command> --help for its flags.
